header.kicker: You've been invited to join Paperclip
header.agentDescription: Review the invite details, then submit the agent information below to start the join request.
header.requiresAccountDescription: Create your Paperclip account first. If you already have one, switch to sign in and continue the invite with the same email.
header.readyDescription: Your account is ready. Review the invite details, then accept it to continue.

pending.title: Request to join {{company}}
pending.waiting: Your request is still awaiting approval. {{approver}} must approve your request to join.
pending.refreshHint: Refresh this page after you've been approved — you'll be redirected automatically.

agentForm.title: Submit agent details
agentForm.description: This invite will create an approval request for a new agent in {{company}}.

auth.createDescription: Start with a Paperclip account. After that, you'll come right back here to accept the invite for {{company}}.
auth.signInDescription: Use the Paperclip account that already matches this invite. If you do not have one yet, switch back to create account.
auth.existsSignIn: An account already exists for {{email}}. Sign in below to continue with this invite.
auth.invalidCredentials: That email and password did not match an existing Paperclip account. Check both fields, or create an account first if you are new here.
auth.maybeExists: An account may already exist for {{email}}. Try signing in instead.

hint.alreadyRegistered: Already signed up before? Use the existing-account option instead so the invite lands on the right Paperclip user.
hint.noAccount: No account yet? Switch back to create account so you can accept the invite with a new login.

accept.bootstrapDescription: This will finish setting up Paperclip.
accept.companyDescription: This will submit or complete your join request for {{company}}.

step1.title: Name your company
step1.description: This is the organization your agents will work for.
step1.missionPlaceholder: What is this company trying to achieve?

step2.title: Create your first agent
step2.description: Choose how this agent will run tasks.

envCheck.title: Adapter environment check
envCheck.description: Runs a live probe that asks the adapter CLI to respond with hello.
envCheck.unsetAnthropicSuffix: is set. You can clear it in this CEO adapter config and retry the probe.

step3.title: Give it something to do
step3.description: Give your agent a small task to start with — a bug fix, a research question, writing a script.
step3.taskDescriptionPlaceholder: Add more detail about what the agent should do...
step3.defaultTaskTitle: Hire your first engineer and create a hiring plan
step3.defaultTaskDescription:
You are the CEO. You set the direction for the company.

- hire a founding engineer
- write a hiring plan
- break the roadmap into concrete tasks and start delegating work

step4.title: Ready to launch
step4.description: Everything is set up. Launching now will create the starter task, wake the agent, and open the issue.

bootstrap.title: Instance setup required

bootstrap.descriptionNoInvite: No instance admin exists yet. Run this command in your Paperclip environment to generate the first admin invite URL:

noBoard.title: No company access
noBoard.description1: This account is signed in, but it does not have an active company membership or instance-admin access on this Paperclip instance.
noBoard.description2: Use a company invite or sign in with an account that already belongs to this org.

cliAuth.title: Approve Paperclip CLI access
cliAuth.description: A local Paperclip CLI process is requesting board access to this instance.
cliAuth.approvedDescription: The Paperclip CLI can now finish authentication on the requesting machine.
cliAuth.restartHint: Start the CLI auth flow again from your terminal to generate a new approval request.
cliAuth.signInRequiredDescription: Sign in or create an account, then return to this page to approve the CLI access request.

boardClaim.title: Claim Board ownership
boardClaim.description: This will promote your user to instance admin and migrate company ownership access from local trusted mode.
boardClaim.claimedDescription: This instance is now linked to your authenticated user.
boardClaim.signInRequiredDescription: Sign in or create an account, then return to this page to claim Board ownership.

signIn.title: Sign in to Paperclip
signIn.subtitle: Use your email and password to access this instance.

signUp.title: Create your Paperclip account
signUp.subtitle: Create an account for this instance. Email confirmation is not required in v1.
